episodes.title: Modeling Scout Linked to Jeffrey Epstein Found Dead in Paris
episodes.description:
French police are investigating the death of modeling scout, Daniel Siad, in Paris who had deep ties to the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. The Paris prosecutor’s office says 24 women have come forward or been identified to report incidents where they were victims or witnessed activity involving Siad and other suspects. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.

episodes.title: Bill Gates to Face House Committee Over Ties to Jeffrey Epstein
episodes.description:
Bill Gates is set to face questions from the House Oversight Committee over his ties to Jeffrey Epstein. Gates, who appears thousands of times in messages and photos in the Justice Department’s Epstein files, acknowledged meeting the late sex offender multiple times but denies any knowledge of his crimes. NBC’s Hallie Jackson reports for TODAY.

episodes.title: Purported Jeffrey Epstein Suicide Note Found by Cellmate: Report
episodes.description:
A former cellmate of Jeffrey Epstein is telling The New York Times that he found a supposed “suicide note” written by the late convicted sex offender just weeks before his death. NBC’s Laura Jarrett joins TODAY to break down the report as well as how it may impact the investigation moving forward.

episodes.title: DOJ Releases Epstein Files Related to Allegations Against Trump
episodes.description:
The Justice Department on Thursday released previously unseen documents from the Jeffrey Epstein files related to a woman who made accusations against President Donald Trump. The woman claims she was assaulted by Trump in the 1980s when she was between the ages of 13 and 15. It’s unclear whether the FBI considered the allegations credible.
